ns2:course.label: Intro to Operations Research
ns2:course.description: (I E 210) Introduction to deterministic and stochastic models in operations research. Topics include: linear programming, integer programming, network models and nonlinear programming, review of basic probability, Bernoulli processes, Markov chains, Markov processes and queuing theory Prerequisite: IE 300 or equivalent; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 415.
